user.description:
Apollo mmWave serves its own cards and dashboard, so there is nothing else to download.

It can also add a dashboard for you: **Apollo mmWave** in the sidebar, at /apollo-mmwave, with a tab for each Apollo mmWave sensor. It is created once, now. Apollo mmWave will not recreate it or change it on its own later, and you can edit or delete it like any other dashboard. To add another one later, go to Settings > Dashboards > Add dashboard and pick **Apollo Radar Tuning** under Community dashboards.

data.create_dashboard: Add the Apollo mmWave dashboard to the sidebar

data_description.create_dashboard: Creates the dashboard once, when you press Submit. Turn this off to place the cards on your own dashboards instead.
data_description.dashboard_admin_only: Other users do not see the dashboard. You can change this later in the dashboard's settings under Settings > Dashboards.

init.title: Apollo mmWave options
init.description: Choose which sensors the Apollo mmWave dashboard shows. The choice is written into the dashboard this integration created, if there is one. A dashboard you made yourself is never changed: set `devices` in its raw configuration instead.

data_description.dashboard_devices: Leave empty to show every Apollo mmWave device automatically; offline ones get a tab with an offline note. Select devices to show exactly those and hide the rest. Once you take control of the dashboard, add or remove devices in the dashboard itself.

error.dashboard_not_updated: The dashboard could not be updated. The Home Assistant log says why.

unknown_device.message: No Home Assistant device has id {device_id}.

multiple_devices.message: Calibration works on one radar at a time; {count} devices were targeted.

calibration_running.message: A calibration or restore is already running for this radar.

no_gate_entities.message: This device has no gate threshold or energy entities. Auto-calibration needs an MSR-1, MSR-2 or R PRO-1 with its radar entities enabled.

engineering_mode_missing.message: This radar has no engineering mode switch, so its gate energies cannot be read.

device_offline.message: The radar is unavailable right now. Check that it is online, then try again.

background_correction_running.message: The LD2412 is still running its background correction. Wait for its status to turn off, then try again.

thresholds_not_numeric.message: The radar has not reported {count} of its threshold values yet.

margin_zero.message: Set at least one headroom. With both margin and margin_pct at 0 the thresholds would equal the highest reading Home Assistant saw, which is only about a tenth of the radar's own frames, so the radar would trigger constantly.

not_allowed.message: Your Home Assistant user is not allowed to control this radar's entities.

no_snapshot.message: There are no saved thresholds to restore for this radar.
